what: Inside the card, a photo shrunk to .54× sits in a window inset 23% on all sides. On hover the window opens to the card edge (clip-path inset 23% → 0) and the photo grows to full size (1.2s expo-out), while a second photo turns on over it in .7s. On release it returns along the same path to the small window. On devices without hover, the photo is shown as is with no window.

options.--fx-inset: Inner window margin when resting, default 23%
options.--fx-scale: Photo size at rest, default .54 (match it to the window size and the photo fits the window exactly: 1 − 2×inset)
options.[data-fx-part=alt]: (If present) Second photo that shows on hover

note: The window covers the whole card, so card text (name, arrow) is visible only at rest. Marks that must stay visible after opening need z-index 2 or higher

from.where: index.html .h-card (hotel list) — original .BrandLink-imageWrapper clip-path inset(23%) 1.2s · .BrandLink-beforeImage scale(.54) 1.2s · .BrandLink-afterImage opacity .7s (all cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))
